title: Fairness-aware rate allocation and burst smoothing for multiplexed tenant streams
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Problem: When many tenants multiplex through shared gateways/proxies (e.g., mobile SDK multiplexing or multi-tenant sidecars), short-lived bursts from a single client can monopolize server slots and cause unfair quota consumption for co-located tenants. This leads to noisy billing spikes, rate-limit thrashing, and poor UX for interactive applications.

Goal: Create a fairness-aware rate-allocation and credit-smoothing protocol that: 1) preserves per-tenant quota correctness (no under/over billing), 2) reduces flash-burst tail-latency and throttle oscillation for multi-tenant connections, and 3) is compatible with existing streaming resume/idempotency semantics and our token-ledger.

Scope: This ticket covers design and implementation of the allocation algorithm in the gateway layer + runtime hooks for final billing canonicalization. It includes test harnesses, telemetry dashboards, and a staged rollout plan (shadow -> canary -> opt-in).

Out of scope: Rewriting client SDKs (we will provide compatibility shims) and long-term quota policy changes (separate PM epic).
acceptance_criteria: Gateway implements per-connection tenant weight table and applies smoothing policy before enqueueing to runtime
End-to-end billing ledger matches canonical token counts within 1 token per stream session for 99.99% of test traces
New telemetry exposes CreditFairnessIndex and BurstPenaltyRatio; thresholds set and alerts configured
Shadow mode demonstrates reduced cross-tenant starvation in synthetic mixed-burst workloads
Canary roll achieves no more than 0.5% increase in billing-delta incidents over baseline and reduces tail-latency P99 by at least 15% for mixed tenants
design_decisions: Use a lightweight tenant-weighted leaky-bucket at the gateway with windowed credit smoothing (default window = 2s) to absorb short bursts without changing ledger semantics
Charge provisional internal credits locally for smoothing, but perform final canonical token attribution in the runtime ledger on stream finalization to avoid double-billing
Introduce an idempotency envelope header (X-RI-Proto-Idemp) for multiplexed frames so reconnects/replays can be deduplicated deterministically
Keep per-tenant token counters authoritative in the runtime; gateway adjustments only affect request scheduling, not final token counts
Expose config knobs for window size, tenant weights, and max-provisional-credits via runtime config and Console feature flags
progress_updates: 2026-03-10: Initial RFC written and reviewed with SRE and Runtime teams. Draft algorithm and test plan attached (confluence link below).

2026-03-11: Design review with Gateway, Runtime, and Billing. Feedback: ensure provisional credits are auditable and traceable; add deterministic idempotency header. Action: add provenance tags for every provisional charge.

2026-03-12: Prototype implemented in gateway shim (node) and run against the synthetic multi-tenant replay harness. Early results: 22% reduction in P99 latency under mixed bursts, but observed 0.7% provisional-credit leak in reconnect-heavy traces. Investigating dedupe logic.
testing_plan: Unit tests for leaky-bucket and tenant-weight math (edge cases: zero-weight tenants, very large bursts)
Integration tests: synthetic harness replaying 10k mixed-tenant traces with reconnects and partial-stream aborts
Fuzz tests to inject out-of-order frames and verify ledger idempotency upon finalization
Shadow deploy: run gateway smoothing in shadow against 1% production traffic for 48 hours and validate billing deltas
Canary: enable smoothing for 5% of GA traffic with opt-in tenant flag and monitor billing-incidents and latency metrics
rollback_plan: Immediate kill-switch via feature flag in gateway config (roll back to pure enqueueing)
If billing deltas exceed 1% incidents for >1 hour, disable smoothing and trigger postmortem
Runtime compensating ledger job to reconcile provisional credits found orphaned during canary (manual trigger)
monitoring_metrics: credit_fairness_index: distribution of provisional credits vs final charges across co-located tenants
burst_penalty_ratio: fraction of bursts that produced provisional requeueing
orphaned_provisional_rate: provisional credits without finalization after 5 minutes
billing_delta_incidents: count of sessions where provisional != final beyond threshold
p99_latency_by_tenant: tail latency improvements after smoothing
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: provisional credits leak and cause perceived underbilling by tenant owners. Mitigation: make all provisional credits emit audit events and conservative TTL; implement fast reconcile job.
Risk: increased complexity in gateway making deploys risky. Mitigation: keep gateway changes minimal and centralize complex logic in a small shim with feature flagging.
Risk: fairness algorithm unfairly penalizes bursty premium customers. Mitigation: tenant weights and opt-outs configurable; PM to review default weights per plan tier.
next_steps: Finalize idempotency envelope and provenance tag format (sprint end)
Land gateway prototype PR and iterate on reconnect dedupe fixes
Collaborate with Billing team to add audit stream for provisional credits
Schedule shadow deploy and prepare Grafana/alert runbook
